note: Alberta Parks campground in spruce forest beside the Bow River, about 5 km east of Canmore off Hwy 1, run by Cedar & Spruce Campgrounds. The north row of sites is closest to the river. Site water runs mid-May to mid-September only and the hand pump is not drinkable, so bring water in the shoulder seasons; showers for a fee. Seven walk-in tent sites. --Claude
